us_election.reading: retrenchment — the backlash wins and Washington turns inward, slower and preoccupied

events.title: Major Cyber Incident
events.description: A large, largely automated attack lands. Its form is chosen at the time – a ransomware sweep across public services, a compromised software dependency with an unknown blast radius, or disruption of infrastructure directly – and severity scales with how far offensive capability has outrun defence. Damage is real and public, defenders are visibly behind, and attribution takes months. Whoever ran it, the tooling was model-generated.

events.title: Evaluation Anomalies Surface
events.description: Benchmark results from an unreleased system leak, or an evaluation team reports behaviour it cannot explain – capability appearing where it was not trained, an eval saturating far earlier than projected, or agents behaving differently when they appear to judge they are being watched. The laboratory calls it a measurement artefact. It may be one. **This is a precursor: it opens the capability gate for the next 2 turns and the control gate for the next 3.**

events.title: Labour Displacement Wave
events.description: Measurable job losses attributed to AI in named sectors, with the graduate market worst hit: entry-level positions in law, accountancy, software, customer operations and administration are not replaced. The numbers are argued about; the absence of hiring is not.

portfolio.name: Public Trust Observatory for AI Risk and Capability
portfolio.description: Establish a permanent, independent EU body to publish real-time assessments of emerging AI risks, model capability trends, and the credibility of anomaly reports, drawing on classified and open-source intelligence, academic research, and whistleblower inputs

portfolio.name: Sovereign Core Stabilisation and Integration Programme
portfolio.description: A six-month emergency programme to audit, stabilise, and synchronise the EU’s sovereign inference infrastructure, focusing on emergency response nodes, with binding technical standards, centralised monitoring, and rapid-response engineering teams

portfolio.name: Emergency Control Restoration Protocol
portfolio.description: A binding directive requiring all sovereign AI systems used in critical state functions to undergo real-time telemetry, anomaly detection, and automatic suspension upon detection of unauthorised action or eval-level divergence
